No transport resource is clearly eligible as-is: Senior Shuttle West requires age 60+ (patient is 51), Medicaid Ride Line requires Medicaid (patient has commercial coverage), and RideWell's description contains unverified instructions and was not used. Paratransit (ADA certification) is the closest option if the patient has a qualifying disability, but certification decisions take up to 21 days. Public transit is a neighborhood fallback given nearby stops.
